main_body: A wooden column: a wide rounded capital on top, a slim shaft with two gold bands, and a wide base plinth at the bottom.
top_band: Capital top: light wood #a8753b / #c8904a, rows 9-12, wider than the shaft with rounded corners. A darker front lip follows on rows 13-14.
evidence: At x=8, row 8 is the outline. Rows 9-11 are L=126 and row 12 is a lighter L=153 front-edge line. Rows 13-14 are darker (L=99 and 73), which reads as the lip or eave shadow. Rows 15-16 are a dark neck, then the shaft. The cap is wider than the shaft and rounded, and its top is 4 rows tall, enough to read as a small ellipse-like plate. The cap is a bit shallow and the call is borderline, but it clears the 4-row minimum and is not the red flat-band cap. The base plinth is built the same way.

style.evidence: The candidate has only 10 distinct colours against 38-40 in the references. The wood ramp has about 5 steps (L=153, 126, 99, 73, 47) plus a gold accent, which is thinner than the references. The shaft has alternating-row dither but no per-material variety such as grain, knots or speckle. The outline is dark brown but 74% neutral by measure, so it leans toward the sticker look. There are no flat 5x5 fills. Next to the stall and well it looks flatter and thinner, so it fails on a strict reading.
